name: v1.7.4
body:
## Overview

Minor release with mostly build fixes.

## What's Changed
* whisper : rename binaries + fix install by @ggerganov in https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/pull/2648
* feat(server): Add option to suppress non-speech tokens by @sachaarbonel in https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/pull/2649
* whisper : rename suppress_non_speech_tokens to suppress_nst by @ggerganov in https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/pull/2653
* feat: expose no-speech probability in segment by @sachaarbonel in https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/pull/2654
* ruby : bug fix on callbacks and no_speech_prob by @KitaitiMakoto in https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/pull/2656
* Add no_speech_thold to cli by @alubbe in https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/pull/2663
* Add --suppress_nst support to cli by @alubbe in https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/pull/2664
* ruby : Fix of C++ header guard name, model URI support, type signature and more by @KitaitiMakoto in https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/pull/2683
* Enable Windows cublas build by @niksedk in https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/pull/2676
* docs: replace Core ML with OpenVINO by @konosky in https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/pull/2686
* rename ggml-cpu-aarch64.c to .cpp by @ego in https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/pull/2687
* readme : fix real-time audio input example build instructions by @samueldurantes in https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/pull/2692
* sync : ggml by @ggerganov in https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/pull/2699
* cli : fix segfault on missing argument by @redzic in https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/pull/2700

## New Contributors
* @sachaarbonel made their first contribution in https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/pull/2649
* @alubbe made their first contribution in https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/pull/2663
* @niksedk made their first contribution in https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/pull/2676
* @konosky made their first contribution in https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/pull/2686
* @ego made their first contribution in https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/pull/2687
* @samueldurantes made their first contribution in https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/pull/2692
* @redzic made their first contribution in https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/pull/2700

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/compare/v1.7.3...v1.7.4
